records.text: Viewer handle Too Much Sausage claimed Charlie Kirk’s security team had not been sued or fired and some members had been promoted; the commenter’s legal identity is unverified.
records.speaker: Too Much Sausage (viewer commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: So that's how that works. Comments from today's episode: Too Much Sausage writes. What a username. How do you guys come up with this stuff? Writes: "And yet Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s security team had one job. Did any of them get sued or fired? No, some even got promoted." No, I'm the one being sued for calling out their security failures. This is just a crazy world we live in. Turning Point, or rather Erika Kirk, could go after UVU for security failures. God forbid Candace (Candace Owens) says something that is so
